MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 243, July 07, 1970 ]
CREATING A NATIONAL COMMITTEE FOR MINERAL EXPLORATIONS AND SURVEY
OPERATIONS
WHEREAS, the continuing search for hydrocarbons and solid minerals in the land and offshore areas of the
Philippines requires the concerned effort of both public and private organizations;
WHEREAS, the resources of public and private organizations can be pooled together to conduct a systematic
compilation of geologic data for coordinated exploration and exploitation of mineral resources of the country;
WHEREAS, the proliferation of mining and oil concessions necessitates efficient use of public funds and
venture capital for exploration and exploitation of mineral resources;
WHEREAS, the resolution of legal, financial, technical, and operational problems relative to the exploration
and exploitation of minerals in the land and offshore areas of the country needs a comprehensive study in
WHEREAS, the creation of a task force composed of representatives from the public and private sectors to
formulate ways and means to carry out exploration and survey operations can contribute much to the
development of mineral resources;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law do hereby create the National Committee for Mineral Explorations and Survey
Operations under the Office of the President composed of the following officials or their authorized
representatives who shall attend the meetings and deliberations of the said body:
The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources
Director, Bureau of Mines
Vice-Chairman
Representatives of the:
Office of the Executive secretary
Presidential Economic Staff
Bureau of Mines
Department of Commerce and Industry
National Science Development Board
Development Bank of the Philippines
Budget Commission
Philippine National Bank
Philippine Air Force
Philippine Navy
Bureau of Coast and Geodetic Survey
Philippine Fisheries Commission
The Committee shall have the following general functions:
1. Undertake comprehensive studies of the legal, financial, technical, scientific and operational aspects of
mineral exploration and exploitation of the land and offshore areas of the Philippines.
2. Coordinate all public and private programs and activities for mineral exploration and exploitation.
3. Oversee the organization of local agencies, public or private, for exploration and survey work in
coordination with appropriate agencies concerned.
4. Assist all agencies concerned with scientific research dealing with exploration, evaluation and exploitation
of mineral resources.
The Committee is hereby authorized to call upon all government departments, bureaus, offices or agencies for
such assistance as it may deem necessary in discharging its functions.
The financial requirement for the operations of the Committee shall be provided first by the above-mentioned
agencies and second, by other entities if the former cannot raise the necessary funds.
The facilities of the above-named agencies shall be made available to the Committee in performing its
functions as well as in undertaking actual exploration and survey operations.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
